sources.citation: Proclamation 10908, Annex I, U.S. note 33(g), (h)(ii), 90 FR 14712-14713. HTS association alone does not establish automobile-parts use.

is_part_for_passenger_vehicle_or_light_t.label: Part for a passenger vehicle or light truck
is_part_for_passenger_vehicle_or_light_t.description: Apply note 33(g): passenger vehicles include sedans, SUVs, crossover utility vehicles, minivans and cargo vans. A listed machine/computer provision alone does not establish automotive use. This fact does not establish USMCA eligibility.

limitations: Constrains the ordinary automobile-parts action; supplies no rate, product scope, date or country-deal assertion.
Other reporting headings, USMCA, knock-down kits, Chapter 98 and additional parts amendments require separate reviewed rules.
